name: Indexes
description: A collection of Index objects that represents all the indexes in the specified document.
remarks: Use the Indexes property to return the Indexes collection. The following example formats indexes in the active document with the classic format. Use the Add method to create an index and add it to the Indexes collection. The following example creates an index at the end of the active document. Use Indexes (Index), where Index is the index number, to return a single Index object. The index number represents the position of the Index object in the document. The following example updates the first index in the active document.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified Indexes object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of indexes in the collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Format
properties.description: Returns or sets a WdIndexFormat that represents the formatting for the indexes in the specified document. Read/write.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an individual Index object in a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The individual object to be returned. Can be a Long indicating the ordinal position of the individual object.

methods.name: MarkEntry
methods.signature: MarkEntry(Range As Range, [Entry As Variant], [EntryAutoText As Variant], [CrossReference As Variant], [CrossReferenceAutoText As Variant], [BookmarkName As Variant], [Bold As Variant], [Italic As Variant], [Reading As Variant]) As Field
methods.description: Inserts an XE (Index Entry) field after the specified range. The method returns a Field object representing the XE field.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The location of the entry. The XE field is inserted after Range.

parameters.name: Entry
parameters.description: The text that appears in the index. To indicate a subentry, include the main entry text and the subentry text, separated by a colon (:) (for example, "Introduction:The Product").

parameters.name: EntryAutoText
parameters.description: The AutoText entry name that includes text for the index, table of figures, or table of contents (Entry is ignored).

parameters.name: CrossReference
parameters.description: A cross-reference that will appear in the index (for example, "See Apples").

parameters.name: CrossReferenceAutoText
parameters.description: The AutoText entry name that contains the text for a cross-reference (CrossReference is ignored).

parameters.name: BookmarkName
parameters.description: The name of the bookmark that marks the range of pages you want to appear in the index. If this argument is omitted, the number of the page containing the XE field appears in the index.

parameters.name: Bold
parameters.description: True to add bold formatting to the entry page numbers in the index.

parameters.name: Italic
parameters.description: True to add italic formatting to the entry page numbers in the index.

parameters.name: Reading
parameters.description: True shows an index entry in the right location when indexes are sorted phonetically (East Asian languages only).

methods.name: MarkAllEntries
methods.signature: MarkAllEntries(Range As Range, [Entry As Variant], [EntryAutoText As Variant], [CrossReference As Variant], [CrossReferenceAutoText As Variant], [BookmarkName As Variant], [Bold As Variant], [Italic As Variant])
methods.description: Inserts an XE (Index Entry) field after all instances of the text in Range.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The range whose text is marked with an XE field throughout the document.

parameters.name: Entry
parameters.description: The text you want to appear in the index, in the form MainEntry[:Subentry].

parameters.name: EntryAutoText
parameters.description: The AutoText entry that contains the text you want to appear in the index (if this argument is specified, Entry is ignored).

parameters.name: CrossReference
parameters.description: A cross-reference that will appear in the index.

parameters.name: CrossReferenceAutoText
parameters.description: The name of the AutoText entry that contains the text for a cross-reference (if this argument is specified, CrossReference is ignored).

parameters.name: BookmarkName
parameters.description: The bookmark name that marks the range of pages you want to appear in the index. If this argument is omitted, the number of the page that contains the XE field appears in the index.

parameters.name: Bold
parameters.description: True to add bold formatting to page numbers for index entries.

parameters.name: Italic
parameters.description: True to add italic formatting to page numbers for index entries.

methods.name: AutoMarkEntries
methods.description: Automatically adds XE (Index Entry) fields to the specified document, using the entries from a concordance file.

parameters.name: ConcordanceFileName
parameters.description: The concordance file name that includes a list of items to be indexed.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Range As Range, [HeadingSeparator As Variant], [RightAlignPageNumbers As Variant], [Type As Variant], [NumberOfColumns As Variant], [AccentedLetters As Variant], [SortBy As Variant], [IndexLanguage As Variant]) As Index
methods.description: Returns an Index object that represents a new index added to a document.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The range where you want the index to appear. The index replaces the range, if the range is not collapsed.

parameters.name: HeadingSeparator
parameters.description: The text between alphabetical groups (entries that start with the same letter) in the index. Can be one of the WdHeadingSeparator constants.

parameters.name: RightAlignPageNumbers
parameters.description: True to align page numbers with the right margin.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Specifies whether subentries are on the same line (run-in) as the main entry or on a separate line (indented) from the main entry. Can be either of the following WdIndexType constants: wdIndexIndent or wdIndexRunin.

parameters.name: NumberOfColumns
parameters.description: The number of columns for each page of the index. Specifying 0 (zero) sets the number of columns in the index to the same number as in the document.

parameters.name: AccentedLetters
parameters.description: True to include separate headings for accented letters in the index (for example, words that begin with "?" and words that begin with "A" are listed under separate headings).

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description: The sorting criteria to be used for the specified index. Can be either of the following WdIndexSortBy constants: wdIndexSortByStroke or wdIndexSortBySyllable.

parameters.name: IndexLanguage
parameters.description: The sorting language to be used for the specified index. Can be any of the WdLanguageID constants. For the list of valid WdLanguageID constants, see the Object Browser in the Visual Basic Editor.
